name: Shokushu Shoujo
source:
You'll play as Asada Mayu as you interact with a mysterious inhuman girl who seduces you with her otherworldly powers (and appendages).

[from [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/PINK001]J-List[/url]]
translation:
玩家将扮演浅田真由，与一名神秘的非人少女互动。对方会以异世界的力量——以及触手——诱惑你。

[译自 [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/PINK001]J-List[/url]]
